verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a schedule-based or recurring-event trigger for Trello workflows. The homepage line "Automate tasks and workflows with Trello" is a generic automation claim that says nothing about recurring schedules. Power-Ups, board buttons and the webhooks API are developer building blocks, manual one-off triggers, or adjacent features, not a documented scheduled or recurring workflow capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work
